verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents automated control testing against integrated systems, with continuous daily monitoring and alerts for failing tests. Admins get proactive email notifications when tests need attention or change status, and failing tests are surfaced in a dashboard, so failures appear well before an annual audit. The documented cadence is daily, though, which does not clearly meet 'within hours'. Missing for 10: evidence of sub-daily or hourly test cadence, independent or hands-on corroboration of monitoring latency, and detail on which tests run against which integrations.
